findings.text: Wynik jest średnią z różnych zadań i grup.
findings.why: The upstream span limits generality: the studies mostly recruited students, mostly measured health habits, and transfer to work settings is not guaranteed. The item replaces this with a neutral 'different tasks and groups', which hides that the evidence base is narrow. The item's own lead example in W praktyce#1 ('zajmę się tekstem', open a file, write a paragraph at a desk) is exactly the work-setting transfer the upstream warns about, and nothing next to it says so. Ocena dowodów#1 also says the result 'dotyczy realizacji celów' without the population or domain. Zmiany w adaptacji lists only an added Polish example and the explanation of d, not the removal of this caveat. AGENTS.md requires keeping conditions, population, uncertainty and source limitations. The caveat could not be checked against the paper because the only source is blocked, but it is not refuted by anything stored either, so dropping it is unsupported.

evidence.text: 这些研究找的多是学生，看的多是健康方面的习惯，搬到工作场景不一定同样管用

findings.fix_direction: Keep the students, health-habits and work-transfer caveat in Ograniczenia (or state a source-backed reason for dropping it), and either mark the writing example as an editorial example of a work task not directly tested, or add a non-work example. findings.text: Wybierz cel, który rzeczywiście chcesz zrealizować.
